_comment: LLM MODEL PROVIDERS — one named entry per backend the harness can run on, so a provider's identity (label, origins, key variable, default/tier models, catalog filters, verified outage seed) is DATA rather than a literal spread across backend_select.py and openai_backend.py. Same rule the rest of the harness follows: a value that a vendor changes on its own schedule lives in references/, not in code. `openai_compatible` providers share openai_backend.py over /chat/completions; the adapter is chosen by backend_select.OPENAI_BACKENDS. Every entry here is a NAME the user can select (`HARNESS_BACKEND=<id>`); nothing in this file is a generic 'custom endpoint' escape hatch.

orcarouter._comment: OrcaRouter Cyber Inference — the named provider for security teams doing authorised, scoped work. One OpenAI-compatible relay; authentication lives on a DIFFERENT origin from inference, and the two are configured independently (spec: never derive one origin from the other by swapping a hostname or appending /v1). `verified_seed` is an outage fallback only: live GET /v1/models is authoritative whenever it answers.
orcarouter.label: OrcaRouter Cyber Inference

tier_model_map._comment: The harness tiers keep the provider's own routing default: `orcarouter/auto` is open to any key and needs no per-model choice. A security team that has unlocked the cyber tier pins one with HARNESS_MODEL_MAP={"opus":"orcacyber-ultra-1.0"} rather than changing the default for everyone.

catalog._comment: Bounds so a catalog response cannot consume unbounded memory or advertise a route this client cannot speak. Every one of these is a ceiling, not a suggestion.

verified_seed._comment: OUTAGE FALLBACK ONLY — used when live discovery fails, and labelled 'degraded' in every surface that shows it. Live GET /v1/models replaces this wholesale on success; the seed is never merged into a live result. Ids keep their vendor/model namespace exactly. `input_modalities` lists ONLY what is verified: an unlisted modality fails closed (the model simply does not appear in that multimodal selector). Missing metadata is left null rather than guessed.
